question: Is the deterministic mid-route test, which uses the real dispatcher and AbortController but mocks routed delivery and binding resolution, sufficient to waive live installed-binding proof for this PR?
rationale: The code path is deterministic and appears correct, but repository policy makes after-fix real behavior proof a merge gate for external code PRs, and the submitted live QA path does not reach the newly changed binding race.

options.title: Require installed-binding proof
options.body: Ask for redacted proof using an installed plugin binding and real routed destination, with cancellation occurring while delivery is in flight.

options.title: Approve a proof override
options.body: Explicitly accept the deterministic regression and QA-bus evidence as sufficient for this internal timing invariant.

recommendation.title: Require installed-binding proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted proof using an installed plugin binding and real routed destination, with cancellation occurring while delivery is in flight.

likelyOwner.reason: The behavior traces to his conversation-binding implementation in the central dispatcher, making him the strongest available owner for the proof-bar decision.
